name: application-field-sensor-map
title: Field Sensor Map
description: A farm plot grid where each cell's color encodes soil moisture level and shows a temperature reading, with a selected-plot detail readout.
useWhen: Agriculture or IoT dashboards need to show many sensor readings across a physical layout (field plots, greenhouse zones) at a glance.
A single metric (moisture) benefits from color-coded density while a secondary metric (temperature) can ride along as text.
avoidWhen: Tracking equipment or asset status rather than a continuous physical-space metric — `Fleet Status Grid`'s labeled status badges communicate discrete states better.
Only a handful of sensors need to be shown — a simple list or stat cards is clearer than a grid.
responsiveBehavior: The 6-column plot grid keeps equal-width square cells at any container size; the legend and header wrap independently above it.
accessibility: Each plot is a real <button>, keyboard-reachable, so users can tab through and select any plot without a pointer.
The selected plot carries aria-current="true" in addition to its ring highlight, and its full reading (moisture % and temperature) is restated as text in the footer, not conveyed by color alone.
Each cell shows its plot ID and temperature as visible text, so the color coding is a supplement to, not a replacement for, textual data.

variants.title: North Field sensor map
variants.description: An 18-plot grid (A1-C6) color-coded by soil moisture (dry/moist/saturated) with per-plot temperature, a color legend, and a selected-plot detail readout with volumetric water content.
accessibility: The selected plot carries aria-current="true"; its reading is restated as text in the footer.

variants.title: North Field sensor map (Dark)
variants.description: Field sensor map adapted for dark surfaces, including moisture-tier colors and the selected-plot ring highlight.
accessibility: Plot labels, temperature text, and the footer readout all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
